{{Quote|I know you went to Prakith. I know you went after Andeddu's holocron. I know you were searching for the secret of eternal life.|[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]|<ref name="DOE" />}}
This '''mission''' was undertaken by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] in [[980 BBY]] in order to obtain [[Holocron of Heresies|Darth Andeddu's holocron]], which Bane hoped would hold the secret to extending one's life. Bane, in his [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]], [[Triumph (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Triumph'']], made the dangerous trip to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. There, he found [[Andeddu's Keep|the fortress]] of [[Darth Andeddu]], where he was attacked by many of [[Malevolence (cult)|Andeddu's followers]]. He defeated all of the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] who attacked him and found Darth Andeddu's holocron in the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] ancient tomb. Quickly leaving the planet, he studied the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] on the trip back to his [[Darth Bane's mansion|home]] on [[Ciutric IV]], forcefully taking the knowledge of [[essence transfer]] from the holocron when the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] refused to teach him.<ref name="DOE" />
